body:
The name parameter is redundant tbh.
You can use `theme->get_path().get_file()`.

The `p_name` parameter is needed for the `_files_moved` case, when the `theme` path might not have been updated yet.  This happens when the `ThemeEditor` has a theme open, but the inspector dock is pointing to a different object.  If the inspector dock is pointing to the edited theme, `InspectorDock::_files_moved` will set the theme's path, so it can be used directly.  Otherwise, the theme's path is still the old value in `ThemeEditor::_files_moved`, so `p_new_path` needs to be used.  Something else seems to update the theme's path later on - if the inspector dock doesn't get it, saving the theme still uses the correct new path.
